entries.text: Lacking motivation to study , and feeling really nervous about my mid term on Friday . I’m not prepared enough and I’m stressing about it . Feeling very tired , and I just want a nap , but I know I can’t . There is so much work to do , and college is really different from high school

Currently feeling really active . Just got home from a light day of classes , but I know I have a lot more work to catch up on . Still a bit stressed about my mid term on Friday , but I looked over some questions and began to understand the concepts more , so I’m not too worried at the same time . Overall , pretty active . Played some sports with my friends today , and it really cheered me up .
